title: Why Only 3% Donate Blood
hook: Only 3% Donate Blood, And The Donor Base Is Shrinking
closing: A stable blood supply depends on more eligible people becoming regular donors.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3% of eligible people donate blood, leaving the entire supply dependent on a tiny volunteer pool.
The blood donor index fell to 60, showing replacement donors are not keeping pace.
